856-2438-5776-6277.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and On Wings of Gold trigger.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

618-1916-8249.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Changeling Titan.
When the Changeling Titan token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the Changeling Titan token.
When the Changeling Titan token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

1742-1978-3363-5159.manaNeeded: {1} or a card from your hand to discard
1742-1978-3363-5159.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of The One Ring that is a 4/4 artifact creature named Mishra's Warform and giving it haste until end of turn
Activate Mishra's Warform by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and drawing a card for each burden counter on it.
Activate Skirge Familiar twice by discarding two cards, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mishra's Warform
Repeat from step 2.
1742-1978-3363-5159.notes: For the first loop, in step 3, you can either discard an additional card for {B} or provide {1}. On subsequent loops, this won't be an issue.

1263-4871-5670-6559.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1263-4871-5670-6559.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Venerated Stormsinger and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1339-1940-4247.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-1940-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Liliana, Dreadhorde General triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

2034-6633-6723-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-5295-7824.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

789-2946-4871-5686.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
789-2946-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2232-4336-4541-5705.manaNeeded: {1} if you control fewer than eight Treasures
2232-4336-4541-5705.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven Treasures.
2232-4336-4541-5705.description:
Activate at least seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least {7}.
Cast Marut by paying at least {7} gained from Treasures, plus an extra up to {1} if needed.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Cloudstone Curio and Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Marut. When Marut enters, it triggers, creating a Treasure for each mana from a Treasure spent to cast it.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying its mana cost.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep enters, it triggers, returning Marut from the battlefield to your hand.
If needed, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
2232-4336-4541-5705.notes: If you control eight or more Treasures, use eight Treasures to cast Marut, which foregoes step 12.

5344-5447-6349.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell from anywhere but your hand this turn.
5344-5447-6349.notablePrerequisites: You have solved Case of the Locked Hothouse.
5344-5447-6349.description:
Cast Charismatic Conqueror from the top of your library by paying {1}{W}.
Charismatic Conqueror's demonstrate ability triggers, causing you and an opponent to copy it.
Resolve the opponent's copy of Charismatic Conqueror, and then resolve your copy of Charismatic Conqueror.
When your Charismatic Conqueror token enters the battlefield,  the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to tap your Charismatic Conqueror token.
Resolve the original Charismatic Conqueror spell.
When the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the opponent's Vampire token enters the battlefield, both Charismatic Conquerors you control trigger, causing you to create at least one 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When your Vampire token enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the Vampire token, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Repeat from step 7.

3652-4053-6797-6989.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Ornithopter.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

5078-6752-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
5078-6752-6900.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

972-3542-4477.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
972-3542-4477.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Palinchron that is an artifact.
When the Palinchron token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Cast Greenwarden of Murasa by paying its mana cost.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, it triggers, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa and the Palinchron token.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa and Palinchron tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat from step 6.
972-3542-4477.notes: If the seven lands can tap to produce {5}{U}{U} or more, this combo will net infinite mana. So long as you produce an extra {U} each loop, you can eventually stop copying Palinchron and copy other creature(s) or artifact(s) instead. You can also create two copies of Greenwarden of Murasa instead to return other applicable cards to your hand.

2173-4771-5220-6634.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

907-5451-5478-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
907-5451-5478-5702.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary. When it enters untapped due to Spelunking, Selesnya Sanctuary and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Wayward Swordtooth.
Because of the additional Wayward Swordtooth token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

759-1247-3690-5963-6549.description:
Cast Sylvan Awakening by paying {2}{G}, causing all lands you control to become creatures until end of turn.
Activate Marvin using Grove of the Burnwillows' second ability by tapping it, adding {R} or {G} and causing each opponent to lose 1 life due to Tainted Remedy.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

944-1117-2866-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

2034-2091-4558-5913.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least eight tapped lands.
2034-2091-4558-5913.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Pinnacle Monk from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Pinnacle Monk by paying its mana cost.
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Pinnacle Monk, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

582-2713-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Brazen Freebooter.
When Brazen Freebooter enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3457-3990-4235.notablePrerequisites:
Seeker of Skybreak and Incubation Druid do not have summoning sickness.
Incubation Druid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3457-3990-4235.description:
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding three mana of any color a land you control could produce.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Incubation Druid.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Incubation Druid.
Repeat.

774-2137-3639.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two lands.
A player controls an indestructible creature.
774-2137-3639.description:
Cast Liturgy of Blood by paying {3}{B}{B}, targeting any indestructible creature.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands to your hand from the battlefield, copying Liturgy of Blood.
Resolve the copy of Liturgy of Blood, failing to destroy the targeted creature and adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two lands onto the battlefield tapped from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-4602.notablePrerequisites:
Xerex Strobe-Knight does not have summoning sickness.
You have a storm count of at least two.
1636-4602.description:
Activate Xerex Strobe-Knight by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Knight creature token.
When the Knight enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

225-515-1636.description:
Activate the land with Squirrel Nest attached by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land with Squirrel Nest attached.
Repeat.

1849-2232-4103-4747.description:
Activate Yidaro's cycling ability by paying {1}{R} and discarding it.
Yidaro triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Yidaro enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio.
Holding priority, activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least eight {R}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Alena from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Yidaro ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Cast Alena by paying {4}{R}.
Alena enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Yidaro from the battlefield to your hand.
 Repeat.

2160-2724-3632.description:
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta enters the battlefield, triggering itself.
In response, activate Erratic Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, returning Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Sundial of the Infinite by paying {1} and tapping it, ending the turn and preventing Wormfang Manta's ETB ability from resolving.
Repeat each turn.

1517-3637-4377.notablePrerequisites: The Mirari Conjecture has two lore counters on it.
1517-3637-4377.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Mirari Conjecture triggers, putting a lore counter on itself, sacrificing itself and copying all instant and sorcery spells you cast this turn.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}.
The Mirari Conjecture triggers, creating a copy of Walk the Aeons.
Resolve both Walk the Aeonss, getting two extra turns after this one.
Cast Brought Back by paying {W}{W}.
The Mirari Conjecture triggers, copying Brought Back.
Resolve the first Brought Back, failing to return any permanents to the battlefield.
Resolve the second Brought Back, returning The Mirari Conjecture from your graveyard to the battlefield.
The Mirari Conjecture triggers, putting a lore counter on itself and returning Brought Back from your graveyard to your hand.
Proceed to your next turn.
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Mirari Conjecture triggers, putting a lore counter on itself and returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Proceed to your next turn.
Repeat.

2882-3200-4675-4694.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
2882-3200-4675-4694.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying {0}.
Urza's Bauble enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
